ref.note: The Flemish Parliament adopts its own operating budget; the dotation is what the Flemish budget passes to it. The Vlaamse Nutsregulator (regulator for electricity, gas and drinking water; role not stated in the budget table) is financed by a dotation voted by Parliament. Ministers' office budgets are mostly staff wages ('LONEN'). Small line. corrected: articles confirmed; cabinet programmes start on p. 163 (heading VF), not p. 162, so locator fixed; the VF heading wraps over two lines ('... VAN DE VLAAMSE' / 'REGERING'). Phrases confirmed; tiny wording change in English ('utility regulator').
